title: Arbitrary bounded known profiles have only O(N log N) posterior missing Fisher

localization.prediction_metric: K1671 controls posterior covariance in the whitened S_0^(-1) mean metric by O(log N), without an anchor or latent identifiability.
localization.score_weight: On the fixed shell with uniform residual margin, the operator norm transfer from S_0^(-1) prediction loss to Omega S_0^(-2) score loss is O(N).
localization.missing_fisher: M_(F,N)=O(N log N), so R_(Omega,N)/4=C_(F,N)-O(N log N).
localization.support_scope: Zero, sparse, degenerating, checkerboard, arithmetic and arbitrary anchor-free bounded profiles are included.
localization.scope_guard: Known coefficients, a fixed four-dimensional orbit, fixed shell and uniform residual margin remain required; no efficient reconstruction algorithm or unknown-profile theorem is claimed.
